title: Spark Pulse Recipe v1
description: Recipe format v1 - the spark-vllm-docker format. Everything lives in a vLLM `command` template. Kept valid forever; new recipes should use v2.

container.description: Container image name to use (e.g. vllm-node, vllm-node-mxfp4).

command.description: vLLM serve command template with {placeholder} interpolation.

description.description: Short description of what this recipe does.

cluster_only.description: This recipe requires more than one node.

solo_only.description: This recipe can only run on a single node.

build_args.description: Extra build arguments for upstream build-and-copy.sh.

mods.description: Mod names or paths to apply before serving.

defaults.description: Default CLI-overridable settings for the serve command.

port.description: Listen port for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

gpu_memory_utilization.description: Fraction of GPU memory to use (0.0-1.0).

env.description: Environment variables to pass into the container.
